reason: Refuted under the value lens. By construction this idea gains 0 on public, which is below the +0.002 bar, and its private gain is smaller than claimed. The cited numbers check out: the z bias with no head is 44b6 +0.177 and 6bba +0.824 um, and with the public head +0.131 / +0.447 um (coordhead_retrain/out_full_P/report.txt l.70-89); the node drop is 124,246 -> 121,219, with 44b6_0b24845f at -10.7% (ext_x138/DIFF.md l.147-149). The claimed spread s = 0.004-0.006 does not hold up. (1) exp52 and x138 share the same three pilkwang detector datasets, the same V1284 head, the edge network and the ILP (DIFF.md l.125-126). The biggest sources of private error (detector misses in dense unseen embryos, the embryo's annotation z-offset) therefore hit both files together. Only the post-ILP tail differs. (2) The pipeline is deterministic run to run (CONTEXT l.1330; the 0.946/0.942 pair came from a leaky sweep, per h_redteam-past notes), so s contains no run noise. It is only the embryo-to-embryo variation of a tail/head interaction. In the lab, tail deltas differ between the two embryos by 0.0005-0.0025 (leaf prune +0.00098 vs +0.00048; edge filter +0.0145 vs +0.0169; l5_confirmation_vs_exp39.md). Realistic s is 0.002-0.004 (a guess). (3) With the realistic public gap of mu = -0.003 (0.950 vs an expected 0.953) or -0.004 (if exp57b = 0.954), E[D+] = +0.00006..+0.0005 (python: mu -0.003, s .002/.003/.004 -> +0.00006/+0.00025/+0.00052). A near-copy F2 already gives +0.00004..+0.0004, so choosing exp52 is worth about 0..+0.0003 in expected private score. P(exp52 is the file that counts) is 0.07-0.23, not 0.25-0.35. (4) The strongest argument, that the whole x138 cluster could collapse on private through the 27,000 s repair guard, can be checked for free: if #34's submit-to-score latency is < 7.5 h, the guard never fired (see the x138-budget-aware-deadline verdict), and most of that tail disappears. (5) 'Head +0.007 on x138 vs +0.002 on ours' is an interaction between the head and each base, measured on the same public embryo. It is not evidence that private and public diverge. The rank argument is real but qualitative, and does not change a score that is far from 0.99.
